title: First All Stars team format
summary: All Stars 1 cast queens into pairs (Shad, Rujubee, Yarlexis, Latrila, Brown Flowers, Mandora). Both teammates were eliminated together each week, and teams were also judged on synergy.

title: Yara tags in on Don't Cha
summary: In All Star Girl Groups (AS-S01-E04), Raven lip-synced against Alexis Mateo to "Don't Cha." Yara Sofia hit the she-mergency button and tagged in; Raven won and Team Yarlexis (Alexis and Yara) was eliminated.

title: Double shantay to Dancing on My Own
summary: In Dynamic Drag Duos (AS-S01-E05), Team Rujubee (Jujubee and Raven) were the sole bottom team and lip-synced to Robyn's "Dancing on My Own." RuPaul eliminated no one.

title: Chad Michaels wins All Stars 1
summary: At The Grand Finale (AS-S01-E06), Jujubee and Shannel were cut before the final lip-sync. Chad Michaels beat Raven to "Responsitrannity (Matt Pop Remix)" and won $100,000.
